newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-S. Barney cuts Santa Fe Pacific.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-S. Barney cuts Santa Fe Pacific.

text.p: -- Smith Barney confirmed it cut its rating on Santa Fe Pacific Gold Corp to neutral from buy.
-- said the outlook for gold prices and gold-related stocks was "not great at the moment."
-- cited unlikelihood that Newmont Mining Corp would raise its bid for Santa Fe to compete with a richer offer from Homestake Mining Co.
-- said a combined Santa Fe-Homestake would be a "show me" stock and would need to demonstrate the benefits of the deal before getting a more favorable rating.
-- said "there are better buys right now. And there will be better buys in the future."
-- Santa Fe lost 1/8 to 15-1/4 in early morning trading.
